definitions.explanation: The academic study of how businesses and organizations are managed and operated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{経営学|けいえいがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I am studying business administration at university.

examples.japanese: {経営学|けいえいがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修士号|しゅうしごう}→修士号：16597_shuushigou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}した→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I obtained a master's degree in business administration.

examples.japanese: {経営学|けいえいがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{起業|きぎょう}→起業：16193_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: Knowledge of business administration is useful for starting a business.

notes:
The academic study of how businesses and organizations are managed. A common university major in Japan.

FORMS:
⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧ (management) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study/science)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {経営学|けいえいがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to study business administration
- {経営学|けいえいがく}{部|ぶ}: department of business administration

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧: management, administration
- ⟦{経営者|けいえいしゃ}→経営者：16188_keieisha⟧: manager, business owner
